Classic scripts under js/ plus artwork.png and sounds/shoot.mp3.

vendor/main.js is patched:
  - artwork and shot URLs come from window.AAS (data: URLs from assets.js)
  - resize updates the mouse scale instead of restarting the round
  - window.AASShowPad() builds the phone sticks (boot calls it on a finger)
  - AAS.onGeneration / AAS.onGameover so the shell can save a best

The neuroevolution loop, bots, and sticks are unchanged.
aux.js (service worker) is not shipped.
